/* MD. Tax - General Code Ann.  8-402.1 (2021)
   (duplicated in the prompt as [1] and [2])

   (a)(1) Franchise tax is imposed for each calendar year on each public service company
          engaged in transmission, distribution, or delivery of electricity or natural gas in the State.
   (a)(2) Tax measured by kWh of electricity or therms of natural gas delivered for final consumption.
   (b)    Tax does not apply to therms of natural gas delivered for final consumption by a
          public service company that is a county or a municipal corporation.
*/

% A company is subject to the franchise tax for a given commodity if it is a public service
% company engaged in the specified activity in the State for that year, and no exemption applies.
statute_md_tax_8_402_1_franchise_tax_applies(Company, Year, electricity) :-
    integer(Year),
    Year >= 2021,
    public_service_company(Company),
    engaged_in_energy_delivery_in_state(Company, maryland, electricity),
    !.
statute_md_tax_8_402_1_franchise_tax_applies(Company, Year, natural_gas) :-
    integer(Year),
    Year >= 2021,
    public_service_company(Company),
    engaged_in_energy_delivery_in_state(Company, maryland, natural_gas),
    \+ statute_md_tax_8_402_1_natural_gas_exempt(Company),
    !.

% Measurement rules.
statute_md_tax_8_402_1_tax_measure(electricity, kilowatt_hours).
statute_md_tax_8_402_1_tax_measure(natural_gas, therms).

% Exemption in subsection (b): only for therms of natural gas delivered for final consumption
% by a public service company that is a county or municipal corporation.
statute_md_tax_8_402_1_natural_gas_exempt(Company) :-
    public_service_company(Company),
    ( company_is_county(Company)
    ; company_is_municipal_corporation(Company)
    ),
    !.

/* MD. State Personnel and Pensions Code Ann.  8-402 (2021)
   Money paid in violation of this section or in violation of any regulation adopted under  8-401
   may be recovered from the officer who pays or authorizes payment or from sureties of that officer's bond.
*/

% A right of recovery exists when there is a payment made in violation and the officer paid or authorized it.
statute_md_state_personnel_8_402_recovery_right(Payment, Officer) :-
    payment_in_violation_of_section_or_regulation(Payment),
    officer_who_paid_or_authorized(Payment, Officer),
    !.

% Alternative recovery target: sureties of the officer's official bond.
statute_md_state_personnel_8_402_recovery_right_against_sureties(Payment, Surety) :-
    payment_in_violation_of_section_or_regulation(Payment),
    officer_who_paid_or_authorized(Payment, Officer),
    surety_of_official_bond(Officer, Surety),
    !.

------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

tenant(t1).

scenario_statement :-

    notice_type(n1, notice_to_vacate_property),
    notice_given_by(n1, L),
    landlord(L),
    notice_given_to(n1, T),
    tenant(T),

    notice_given_in_year(n1, 2021),
    !.

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   Reasoning: do the provided statutes impose a landlord-notice content duty?
------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

% Collect legal duties encoded from the provided statutes.
% (These are the only statutes we are allowed to use here.)
legal_duty_encoded(franchise_tax_imposed_on_public_service_company).
legal_duty_encoded(recovery_of_money_paid_in_violation_from_officer_or_sureties).

% The provided statutes impose no duty on landlords about the content of a notice to vacate.
% We express this as: there is a requirement only if some encoded statute creates it.
legal_requires_landlord_notice_state_amount_owed(_State, _Year) :-
    % If any statute in this program created such a requirement, it would be represented here.

    fail.

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

housing_answer(yes) :-

    jurisdiction(State),
    focus_year(Year),
    legal_requires_landlord_notice_state_amount_owed(State, Year),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
